npcs.name: Hallgerd Rindasdottir
npcs.idle: My husband Bard was bitten at the new moon. The full moon's in nine days.

npcs.name: Seithkona Ulfrun
npcs.idle: Wolfsbane and warder's blood. I've seen it work. Once.

npcs.name: Ranger Eyvor
npcs.idle: Sidhe in Skona. Sidhe! Three days' march from the jarl's hall.

npcs.name: Ranger-Captain Jodur
npcs.idle: The Rangers have watched the ravine since before the werewolves came. We'll watch it after they're gone.

npcs.name: Seithkona Saga
npcs.idle: The moon's afraid. You can see it, if you know how to look.

quests.title: Moonbound
quests.offer:
My husband Bard was bitten by a werewolf at the new moon. When the moon's full, he'll change - and stay changed. He ran into the ravine so he wouldn't hurt me.

Seithkona [Ulfrun] knows a cure. One cure. Will you [help Bard]? Nine days. We have nine days.

topics.Ulfrun: The seithkona. She's just over there, by the fire. She's done this before.

quests.summary: Hallgerd's husband was bitten by a werewolf and fled into the ravine. A cure exists, if it can be made before the full moon.

steps.goal: Ask Seithkona Ulfrun about the cure
steps.say: Wolfsbane from the old grove the ra guard, west of here - that's the first part. And the blood of a werewolf warder, for the second. Mix them by moonlight and it's one dose. Only one. I'll not lie to you about that. Bring me the [wolfsbane] and the blood and I'll brew it.

steps.goal: Fight through the ra guarding the wolfsbane grove
Gather wolfsbane from the old grove
steps.text: Purple hoods, nodding in the ash. You gather an armful.

steps.goal: Take the blood of werewolf warders
steps.text: You fill Ulfrun's flask. On the last warder's belt: a child's wooden doll.

steps.goal: Find Bard at the were-hut in the south-west
steps.text: Bard is here. Half-changed: hair on his arms, teeth too long. And curled up beside him, asleep, a little girl with ears too pointed.

steps.say:
Hallgerd sent you. I knew she would.

That's Ylfa. They bit her a year ago. She's been living with them. She's eight. She found me the first night and stayed. She thinks I'm her father now. The pack's [coming] for her.

steps.text: The pack falls back into the ravine. Bard is bleeding, grinning, and still mostly himself.

stages.name: Keep Bard alive
stages.announce: Howls in the ravine. The pack knows you're here.
stages.thanks: I'm still me. For a few more days.

stages.name: Grimfang, Wolfaur Headsman
stages.announce: A huge wolfaur with an executioner's axe. 'The cub is the pack's. And so are you, bitten one.'

steps.say:
One dose. Ulfrun was clear.

I could [drink it], and go home to Hallgerd, and Ylfa goes back to the pack - or into the ravine alone. Or [Ylfa drinks it]. She's eight. She could go home - she has a mother in Skona, she told me. And I'd stay what I'm becoming.

You choose. I can't. Every time I try, I see her face.

options.say: ...Forgive me, little one. ...It's bitter. Gods, it's bitter. Take me home before I change my mind.
Yes. Here, little one. Drink. ...There. Take her home. Tell Hallgerd I love her. Tell her not to come looking at the full moon.

steps.say:
He's home. Cured. Ulfrun says it took.

He told me about the girl. He goes to the edge of the ravine at night and listens. He'll do that for the rest of his life, I think. But he's home.

You brought me a child, and not my husband.

Her mother came from Skona village this morning and fell on her knees in the mud. I watched. I couldn't hate either of them. On the full moon I'll go to the ravine's edge. He told me not to. I'm going anyway.

child.text: Take this. The girl made it for you.

quests.title: The Sidhe's Maps
quests.offer:
There are sidhe in Skona. A camp of them in the far west - Hibernian druids, three days from the jarl's hall. I sent my best scout, Thorvald, to watch them. That was a month ago.

He's sent no word. Either they caught him or he's found something worth the silence. Will you [find Thorvald]?
quests.summary: A Midgard scout sent to watch a sidhe camp in western Skona has sent no word in a month.

steps.goal: Head west through the timber-cat woods
steps.text: Big cats in the undergrowth. And on a tree, a ranger's mark, scratched fresh: Thorvald's sign.

clue.name: a scout's cloak, pinned with a Hibernian brooch

steps.text: Thorvald's cloak, folded, with a sidhe brooch pinned to it - a gift, not a trophy. The post hasn't been used in weeks. He's gone in.

steps.goal: Fight through the sidhe camp's outer guard
Find Thorvald in the sidhe camp
steps.say:
Gods, keep your voice down - you're from Eyvor? ...Listen.

I got in. I got close to one of their seers, Niamh. Close. She trusted me. She showed me their maps - every road from here to the jarl's hall, every ford, every weak wall. I have them. I was waiting for a chance to run. Then she - then I started to [care].

steps.goal: Fight the sidhe druid who comes for Thorvald
steps.text: The druid falls. Behind the tents, a woman in green stands very still, looking at Thorvald.

stages.name: Draoi Fionnbarr
stages.announce: A sidhe druid steps out of the trees, staff burning green. 'My sister trusted you, Northman. Give back what you stole.'

steps.goal: Decide what becomes of the sidhe maps
steps.say:
That was her brother. And that's her, watching us.

The maps would save Midgard - with them the jarl knows every road Hibernia means to use. Eyvor will make me a hero. And Niamh will know what I was. [Take the maps].

Or I [give them back]. To her. I go home with nothing, and Eyvor knows I failed, and Niamh knows I chose her. I can't. You do it.

options.say: ...Then let's go. Don't look back at her. I'm not going to.
Then I'll walk them over to her myself. ... She took them. She didn't say anything. Let's go home.

steps.say:
The sidhe maps. All of them. The jarl will give Thorvald a hall for this.

He hasn't said a word since he got back. He sits looking west. Here - from the jarl's purse.

He gave them back. He had the maps of half Hibernia's war in his hands and he gave them back to a sidhe witch.

I should have him whipped. I won't. I've been in love too. Here - take something. Don't tell the jarl.

quests.title: Skulkers in the Woods
quests.offer:
Werewolf skulkers in the north woods - the hold's scouts. They watch our camp, and they report.

Will you [hunt the skulkers]?
quests.summary: Werewolf skulkers, the werewolf hold's scouts, watch the Rangers' camp from Skona's north woods.

steps.goal: Hunt the werewolf skulkers about 320 m north-east of Ranger-Captain Jodur

steps.say: Blind for a while. Good. The hold's busier than it's ever been. Something's gathering.

quests.title: Wolverines
quests.offer:
Young wolverines in the north woods - driven out of the middle of the ravine. The werewolves don't share.

Will you [clear them off the trail]?
quests.summary: Young wolverines driven out of Skona's middle by the werewolves block the north woods trail.

steps.goal: Clear the young wolverines about 170 m north-east of Ranger Eyvor

steps.say: The trail's open. Everything in the ravine is running from the middle. Everything except the wolves.

quests.title: Bad Dreams
quests.offer:
The great tinglers in the meadows feed on dreams, and the circle's dreams have been very bad. They've grown fat. They come to the stones at night.

Will you [drive them off]?
quests.summary: Great tinglers fat on bad dreams come to the Seithkona Circle's stones at night.

steps.goal: Drive off the great tinglers about 220 m west of Seithkona Saga

steps.say: Better. We'll sleep, a little. The dreams won't stop, though. We all dream the same thing: a wolf running after the moon.

quests.title: The Howling Wind
quests.offer:
The wind spirits on the eastern heights carry the werewolves' howls to the moon. Every night, louder. The moon hears them.

Will you [silence the wind]?
quests.summary: Wind spirits on Skona's eastern heights carry the werewolves' howls to the moon.

steps.goal: Silence the wind spirits about 530 m south of Seithkona Saga

steps.say: Quieter. Now I can hear what they were drowning out.

quests.title: The Moon-Stone
quests.offer:
The circle's moon-stone shows the moon's road. Read it with me - stand at the stone at the circle's heart and look.

Will you [read the stone]?
quests.summary: The Seithkona Circle's moon-stone shows the moon's road across the sky.

steps.goal: Read the moon-stone at the circle's heart
steps.text: In the stone the moon runs across the sky, and behind it runs a wolf, gaining. Under the wolf, a hall of ice in the north-west: Raumarik. And in the middle of the ravine, wolves gathering at a hold, to go north.

steps.say:
Hati. Fenrir's son, who hunts the moon. When he catches it, the long winter comes. And the hold in our ravine - Ulfhamr - is where his host gathers before it goes north.

Go to Ranger-Captain Jodur. The Rangers mean to break that hold.

quests.title: The Hold's Guards
quests.offer:
The werewolf guards patrol the ground round Ulfhamr. Every one we kill is one less on the walls when the Rangers march.

Will you [thin the guards]?
quests.summary: Werewolf guards patrol the ground round Ulfhamr, the werewolf hold in Skona's middle.

steps.goal: Thin the werewolf guards about 220 m south-east of Ranger-Captain Jodur

steps.say: Good. The Rangers will hear of it. Every one tells them we can win.

quests.title: The Warders
quests.offer:
The werewolf warders keep the hold's magic - wards of blood and moonlight. While they stand, the hold can't be broken.

Will you [break the warders]?
quests.summary: Werewolf warders keep Ulfhamr's wards of blood and moonlight.

steps.goal: Break the werewolf warders about 190 m west of Seithkona Ulfrun

steps.say: The wards are weaker. I felt them give. The hold can be taken now.

quests.title: The Wolfaur Headsmen
quests.offer:
The wolfaur headsmen hunt the south of the ravine for the hold - and they hunt men. They'll lead Hati's host north when it marches.

Bring friends. Will you [hunt the headsmen]?
quests.summary: Wolfaur headsmen hunt men in Skona's south for the werewolf hold.

steps.goal: Hunt the wolfaur headsmen about 710 m south-east of Ranger-Captain Jodur

steps.say: The hunters hunted. Good. Now - the hold itself.

quests.title: Ulfhamr
quests.offer:
Ulfhamr. Go and look at it - count the wolves on the walls, find the gate. Then come back and tell me we can win.

Will you [scout the hold]?
quests.summary: The Wolfsbane Rangers mean to break Ulfhamr, the werewolf hold in Skona's middle.

steps.goal: Creep up to the ridge above Ulfhamr
steps.text: A hold of black logs and bones, wolf-skulls on every post. Howling from inside, and the warden on the gate - a werewolf in a captain's mail.

clue.name: a post hung with fresh pelts

steps.text: Wolf-pelts - and men's cloaks, rangers' grey among them. Scratched in the post: 'WHEN THE MOON RUNS RED, NORTH TO HATI.'

steps.say:
Rangers' cloaks. Then we take it for every one of them.

The Rangers will march when the ravine is behind us - every skulker, every warder, every headsman broken tells the men they can win. Be there.

quests.title: The Green Orms
quests.offer:
The green orms on the western shore have come up out of the water and onto the paths. They've never done that.

Will you [drive them back]?
quests.summary: Green orms have come up out of the water onto the paths of Skona's western shore.

steps.goal: Drive back the green orms about 400 m north of Thorvald

steps.say: Back in the water. Something in the ravine frightened them. Everything's frightened, this year.

quests.title: The Strangers on the Strand
quests.offer:
The sidhe on the strand - strangers, from somewhere far off. They've always been odd. Now they shoot at anyone who comes near.

Will you [push them back]?
quests.summary: The sidhe strangers on Skona's western strand shoot at anyone who comes near.

steps.goal: Push back the sidhe gaoite about 100 m north of Thorvald

steps.say: They said something, as they fell back. 'The winter wolf comes, and your moon dies.' Even the strangers know.

quests.title: The Angry Wood
quests.offer:
The dryads of the south-east wood have turned on everyone. Something's burning their trees - from the south.

Will you [calm the wood]?
quests.summary: The dryads of Skona's south-east wood have turned on everyone; something from the south burns their trees.

steps.goal: Calm the dryad blossoms about 820 m east of Bard

steps.say: Calmer. They showed me the burnt trees. Burnt from inside - claws, and fire.

quests.title: The Drake Trail
quests.offer:
Young silverscale drakes on the trail up from Malmohus. The dragon's brood, coming north. They'll find the werewolves sooner or later - and I don't know who I'd rather won.

Bring friends. Will you [break the drakes]?
quests.summary: Young silverscale drakes come north up Skona's drake trail from Malmohus.

steps.goal: Break the young silverscale drakes about 800 m east of Bard

steps.text: A drakulv banner: the dragon's eye over a wolf's skull. Stitched under it: 'The Mother's brood goes before her. Let the wolves and men kill each other, and the brood takes what's left.'

steps.say: Let the wolves and men kill each other. That's their plan. Both threads, one trap. Midgard has to win both.
